name: Secure and Hold
blurb: Hold markers across four turning points. Kills matter, but ground matters more.

kills.notes: Raised from 2 after an 880-battle sweep: the objective half of this mission pays up to 3 VP a turning point and scales with body count (roster size correlated +0.73 with objective VP), while the kill half scaled with nothing because the cap bit before lethality could show. At 4 the cap is, in practice, no cap — one side almost never takes more than four operatives off the board in a turning point — and roster size's correlation with win rate falls from +0.100 to +0.019.
